bmt-2021-power-03.prompt: **Question 1.3.** A *tree* is a graph in which any two vertices are connected by exactly one path (so it has no cycles). If a tree has $n$ vertices, how many edges does it have? Prove your result. (Hint: induction.)
bmt-2021-power-03.answer: A tree with $n$ vertices has $n-1$ edges.
